AWS Data Engineer (Python and PySpark)

Location: Nashville, TN
Employment type: Contract
Indicative rate: $60–$70/hr

Design, build, and operate scalable data integration and batch-processing solutions using Python, PySpark, and AWS. Develop pipelines that extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, and create dependable datasets for downstream use. Work with business and technical partners to implement data requirements, tune SQL and processing workflows, and troubleshoot production issues. Contribute to reliable, maintainable data solutions across large data domains.

Core skills
Python
PySpark
AWS
SQL
ETL/ELT
Batch processing
Data integration
Required qualifications
Professional experience building data pipelines with Python and PySpark.
Experience designing and operating batch data processing workflows.
Strong SQL skills, including query development and optimization.
Experience developing ETL/ELT and data integration solutions.
Ability to transform and process large datasets.
Experience troubleshooting data workflows and improving reliability.
Ability to translate business requirements into maintainable data solutions.
Preferred qualifications
Experience with AWS data services such as Glue, S3, Lambda, or Step Functions.
